parameters.description:
`elks-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `elks_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream 46elks URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay an SMS through your own 46elks account by posting a native 46elks payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's base64 of user:password for HTTP basic auth
